_source.describes: The hexcrawl Landmarks generator: FLAIL!'s five d20 axes.
_source.status: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
_source.rationale: FLAIL!'s own Landmarks table, reproduced in face order, which the Third-Party Licence permits. A landmark is the thing you see from the next hex; a location is the thing you walk into. They share four axis names — separate tables, separate field paths. Checked against the book, column by column: Condition and Key Feature have no row in common with the Locations table, Occupant shares only the face-20 catch-all, and Biome is identical throughout. The identical rows are copied here rather than shared, because a lock stores a table position and not a phrase, so a shared path would let a locked Biome resolve against the other generator's rows on switching kind. Copying also leaves either table free to be corrected without disturbing a lock saved against the other. The Biome column repeats entries deliberately, exactly as the book prints it.
